# Import data

Pending

```{r}
#| message: false
amusement_park <- read_csv(
    file = "../000_data/007_chapter_7.csv"
) |>
    mutate(
        weekend = factor(
            x = weekend,
            ordered = FALSE
        ),
        num.child = as.integer(num.child),
        logdist = log(
            x = distance,
            base = exp(1)
        )
    )
```

# Summary statistics

Pending

```{r}
amusement_park |>
    skim()
```

# Correlation matrix

```{r}
#| message: false
#| warning: false
correlation_matrix <- amusement_park |>
    select(
        num.child,
        rides:logdist
    ) |>
    correlate()

correlation_matrix |>
    autoplot(
        triangular = "lower"
    )
```
